allowed_successor_change: Quote the null cell label as a literal string in the GitHub Actions matrix/workflow. All frozen method code, geometry, synthetic parameters, world counts, seed namespaces, alpha, and Wilson gates must remain unchanged.

using partial private_A2 output from the invalid run to tune the method
changing the self-field estimator, bandwidth, endpoint exclusion, null reference, alpha, or Wilson thresholds
